note: One-shot (ADR-06, PR #30 review r1 R1-02; r2/r3: no chmod inside the container because with only CAP_CHOWN a root process cannot chmod a directory owned by another uid (CAP_FOWNER); the host-side directory mode 0755 is set by compose render): a fresh named volume is a bind directory under runtime/volumes/ created by the host user (mkdir, 0755), so the non-root copier wiki_assets (1000:1000) cannot write to it on a Linux host whose uid is not 1000. This container runs the same overlay image as root with cap_drop ALL and only CAP_CHOWN added back (manifest/hardening.json, controls user + cap_add), chowns the volume to 1000:1000 and exits; wiki_assets waits for it with service_completed_successfully. It never touches anything but the volume mount.
